## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm type-check`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass locally
- [ ] Tests cover the change (or it is docs or tooling only)
- [ ] A changeset is included (`pnpm changeset`) if what `stuntdouble` does changes
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), per the [DCO](https://developercertificate.org/)
